common.tagline: Your companion for barangay health work.

home.heading: Welcome to BHW Connect
home.body: This is the foundation shell for Phase 1. Features roll out one increment at a time.

privacy.heading: Privacy Notice
privacy.body: The full Data Privacy Act notice ships with the consent flow in a later increment.

login.heading: Log in
login.errorDeactivated: This account has been deactivated. Please contact your barangay admin.
login.errorLockedOut: Too many attempts. Please try again in 15 minutes.
login.reasonIdleTimeout: You were signed out after 8 hours of inactivity. Please log in again.
login.reasonDeactivated: This account has been deactivated. Please contact your barangay admin.

changePassword.heading: Set a new password
changePassword.body: For your security, please set a new password before continuing.
changePassword.hint: At least 8 characters. No need for symbols or numbers.
changePassword.errorTooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters.
changePassword.errorTooCommon: That password is too common. Please choose a different one.
changePassword.errorUpdateFailed: Something went wrong. Please try again.

consent.heading: Data Privacy Notice
consent.intro: Before you continue, please review how BHW Connect handles your data.
consent.pointCollectionBody: Your name, contact number, address, and the questions you ask the Chat Guide.
consent.pointPurposeBody: To run your account, support your barangay health work, and improve the Knowledge Base.
consent.pointRetentionBody: Chat and usage data for up to 24 months; account records for as long as your account is active.
consent.pointRightsBody: You may ask your admin to export or correct your data at any time, consistent with the Data Privacy Act.
